reason: ASK-1242: fable-escalation.md is paths-scoped, so a bare claude -p eval never loaded it and its fixture measured the un-ruled model. skill-trigger-eval.py now refuses such a fixture unless it declares a seed_path, and fable-escalation.json now declares one. The rule's measurement sentence says which, per the issue's acceptance.

edits.insert:
This rule is paths-scoped,
so a bare `claude -p` never loads it: the fixture declares a `seed_path` matching
`**/scripts/**`, and the harness runs it in a temp copy with that file created and
named in every prompt (ASK-1242). The harness refuses a paths-scoped fixture that
has neither a seed nor a matching path in each prompt. The seed makes the rule
loadable, not loaded: whether the model opens the file is still its own call.
